findings.evidence: TotalRamification.lean:39 docstring: 'In the namespace `NumberField`, all for `Module.finrank ℚ K = 2`'; the degree hypothesis is the variable `hK` (line 54 region), not part of any name. A ramified prime of a general number field need not satisfy e = 2.
findings.fix: Put the quadratic-presentation slice in `NumberField.Quadratic` (matching the `Quadratic/` directory) rather than bare `NumberField`, or otherwise carry the degree-two hypothesis in the name (`..._of_finrank_eq_two`).
findings.issue: Lemmas that hold only for `finrank ℚ K = 2` (the hypothesis is the section variable `hK`, invisible in the name) now sit unqualified in the canonical `NumberField` namespace, so they read as general number-field facts that are false in general: `NumberField.ramificationIdx_eq_two_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `primesOver_eq_singleton_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (135), `ncard_primesOver_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (142), `inertiaDeg_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (155), `map_span_eq_sq_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (161), `map_eq_self_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (174), `mem_ramifiedPrimes_iff_ramificationIdx_eq_two` (188); same for the quadratic-presentation family `NumberField.finrank_rat_eq_two`, `coe_gen_sq`, `coe_gen_sq_ratCast`, `gen_notMem_range`, `not_isSquare_radicand`, `trace_gen_eq_zero`, `discr_one_gen`, `discr_one_halfGen` (Quadratic/Basic.lean 56–127), `halfGen`, `coe_halfGen`, `adjoin_gen_eq_top_of_mod_four_ne_one`, `discr_eq_four_mul_of_mod_four_ne_one`, `discr_eq_of_squarefree_of_mod_four_eq_one` (Quadratic/RingOfIntegers.lean 231–337), `quadraticConj`, `ringOfIntegersQuadraticConj` (Quadratic/Conjugation/Basic.lean 85, 114), and `classGroupMk0_sq_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (Quadratic/RamifiedPrimesClassGroup.lean 46). `gen`/`radicand` also name nothing in `NumberField`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib's canonical unit-group namespace: `namespace NumberField.Units` at Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/Units/Basic.lean:66 (`torsion`), Units/DirichletTheorem.lean:359 (`rank`), Units/Regulator.lean:266 (`regulator`).
findings.fix: Move the `(𝓞 F)ˣ` declarations into `NumberField.Units` and drop the now-redundant `units_`/`_units` component (e.g. `NumberField.Units.sq_index_le`, `Units.card_elementaryTwoQuotient`, `Units.twoRank`).
findings.issue: Facts about `(𝓞 F)ˣ` land in bare `NumberField` with `units_`/`_units` spliced into the name — `NumberField.units_sq_index_le` (and `_of_finrank_le/_eq/_eq_one`, `card_units_elementaryTwoQuotient_*` in the same file), `NumberField.units_sq_index_eq`, `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_units`, `twoRank_units` (Units/ElementaryTwoQuotient.lean 61–83), `NumberField.unitsMulEquivTorsionProdMultiplicative` (Units/Dirichlet.lean 77) — while this same PR correctly puts the regulator lemmas in `NumberField.Units` (EffectiveBounds/Regulator.lean:41).

findings.evidence: File body: `theorem not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime {p l : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hl : l.Prime) (hne : p ≠ l) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ)` inside `namespace NumberField.Internal` (line 21), under `public section`.
findings.fix: Name it in the namespace of its subject, e.g. `Int.not_natCast_dvd_natCast_of_prime_of_ne`, and drop the `NumberField.Internal` wrapper.
findings.issue: `NumberField.Internal.not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime` states `¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ)` for distinct nat primes — no number field occurs anywhere in it — yet it is now a public declaration in Mathlib's canonical `NumberField` namespace.

findings.evidence: `namespace NumberField.WorkedExamples` (line 64) containing `classNumber_adjoinRoot_sqrt_neg_five_le` (77); `namespace NumberField.Internal` in both Internal/*.lean files, both under `public section`.
findings.fix: Keep repo-scaffolding namespaces under `TauCeti.` (e.g. `TauCeti.NumberField.Internal`, `TauCeti.WorkedExamples`), or make the helpers `private`/`protected` and give the genuinely canonical statements canonical names (`NumberField.discr_cyclotomicField_four`).
findings.issue: Organizational (non-mathematical) sub-namespaces are created inside the canonical namespace: `NumberField.WorkedExamples` here and `NumberField.Internal` (Internal/QuadraticIntegralBasis.lean:26). `Internal` and `WorkedExamples` classify repo scaffolding, not objects, and now claim canonical `NumberField.` names.

findings.evidence: Line 80–81: `theorem classNumber_le_bound (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] : (NumberField.classNumber F : ℝ) ≤ |(discr F : ℝ)| * 4 ^ Module.finrank ℚ F`.
findings.fix: Rename to describe the right-hand side, e.g. `classNumber_le_abs_discr_mul_four_pow_finrank`, and update the docstring references in this file and in WorkedExamples.lean.
findings.issue: `NumberField.classNumber_le_bound` does not describe its conclusion — `bound` names nothing in the statement `(classNumber F : ℝ) ≤ |discr F| * 4 ^ finrank ℚ F` — and in the canonical namespace, next to Mathlib's `NumberField.classNumber`, it reads as *the* class-number bound.

findings.evidence: Lines 414–417: `theorem card_ideal_absNorm_le … : {I | …}.Finite ∧ (({I | …}.ncard : ℝ)) ≤ X ^ 2 * 2 ^ Module.finrank ℚ F`; consumers use `card_ideal_absNorm_le F _ |>.2` (line 423 region).
findings.fix: Split or rename, e.g. `finite_and_ncard_ideal_absNorm_le` (or a `finite_setOf_ideal_absNorm_le` plus `ncard_ideal_absNorm_le`), consistent with the `ncard_` neighbours.
findings.issue: `NumberField.card_ideal_absNorm_le` proves a conjunction (`Set.Finite ∧ ncard ≤ …`), but the name advertises neither the finiteness conjunct nor the `Set.ncard` measure, and it contradicts its own neighbours `ncard_ideal_absNorm_le_nat` / `ncard_ideal_absNorm_le_of_finrank_le` in the same file.

summary: The move into Mathlib's canonical `NumberField` namespace turns several repo-local names into unqualified canonical ones that overstate their scope (quadratic-only ramification and presentation lemmas), scatters unit-group material outside `NumberField.Units` while this same PR puts the regulator lemmas inside it, and squats the canonical namespace with organizational sub-namespaces (`Internal`, `WorkedExamples`), including one lemma with no number field in its statement.
